query:
SELECT o.musicians_read_archive,
                  m.role AS "role?",
                  COALESCE((SELECT u.is_system_admin FROM "user" u WHERE u.id = $2), false)
                      AS "is_system_admin!"
           FROM organization o
           LEFT JOIN membership m ON m.organization_id = o.id AND m.user_id = $2
           WHERE o.id = $1
